title: Gift Registry Entry Failure Rate
dataSources: Gift registries (`gift:registry`), Amazon wishlists (`amazon:wishlist`), holiday card sends (`holiday:card`), birthday budgets (`birthday:budget`), and thank-you notes (`thankyou:note`).
app: Gift registry exports, Amazon wishlist snapshots, holiday card mail logs, birthday budget trackers, and thank-you note reminders ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=gift:registry
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(purchase_status,"unknown"))
| eval failed=if(match(status_value,"error|fail|alert|overdue|late|stale|breach"),1,0)
| stats count as events, sum(failed) as failed_events by event_name
| eval failure_pct=round(100*failed_events/events,1)
| sort - failure_pct - failed_events
description: Measures how often gift registry entry records land in an unhealthy or exception state for each event.
value: A plain failure-rate view highlights noisy devices, flaky automations, and habits that repeatedly slip.
implementation: Normalize purchase_status values into good or bad states and review the failure percentage per event.
visualization: Bar chart of failure percentage by entity.
grandmaExplanation: It maps which parts of your gift registry entry data keep ending up in a bad state instead of working cleanly.
